name: made-to-stick
tagline_zh: 你的方案总被忘？用SUCCESs清单把话钉进对方脑子。不靠文采，靠六个钩子：简单、意外、具体、可信、动情、故事。
tagline_en: Your pitch keeps slipping? SUCCESs checklist nails it into memory—simple, unexpected, concrete, credible.
desc_en: Craft messages that are understood, remembered, and drive action using the SUCCESs checklist (Simple, Unexpected, Concrete, Credible, Emotional, Stories). Use when the user mentions "make it memorable", "no one remembers our pitch", "tagline", "value proposition", "why the message isnt landing", "curse of knowledge", or "concrete language". why_zh: 别的模板只教你怎么写，它拆解为什么被记住。每条建议都带反例和改法，直接照做。
why_en: Other templates tell you what to write; this dissects why it sticks. Every tip has before/after examples—just copy.
